paragraphs: AI: "If I Could Only Own 1 Artificial Intelligence (AI) Memory Stock for the Next 5 Years, It Wouldn't Be Micron." (The Motley Fool) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Why Artificial Intelligence Could Threaten The Future Of Science" (Forbes).
